title: Refactor legacy Figma instances, unify token taxonomy, and add publish gating
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Over the last 18 months multiple quick fixes and feature experiments introduced a large number of legacy component instances and duplicated token scales across buttons, tables, and chart primitives. These are creating visual regressions, bloated publish payloads, and confusing handoffs to engineering. Goal: consolidate token scales into a single taxonomic set, migrate or replace legacy instances with canonical component variants, clean up auto-layout constraints for responsive flows, and add a publish gating checklist in the Figma library to prevent future regressions. This ticket covers design work + automated detection patterns we will hand off to DesignOps for enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical token taxonomy defined and documented in Confluence (spacing, type, radii, semantic color aliases) and linked in the Figma file
All legacy button and table instances (identified by the instance-report) are either remapped to canonical variants or listed with a migration PR for engineering before library publish
Auto-layout constraints normalized for responsive columns (tables) and stacked button groups across small/medium/large breakpoints
A lightweight publish gating checklist file is added to the library that prevents 'Publish' without: token file sync, zero orphaned variants, and resolved missing overrides
Design review sign-off from PM and Frontend lead (comment thread closed) and at least one staging publish with QA sampling (10 representative pages) showing no regressions
tasks: Inventory: run instance-export script and produce CSV of legacy instances by component and page
Define token taxonomy doc (Confluence): include migration map from old token names to new semantic tokens
Create canonical variants for button scales (compact, default, comfy) and table row density variants
Batch-migrate low-risk instances via Figma swap plugin; create migration tickets for high-risk bespoke pages
Refactor auto-layout constraints for table rows and chart cards to support content-wrapping and pinned actions
Add publish gating checklist frame to library and document required pre-publish steps in the PRD
Coordinate with DesignOps to schedule a staging publish and collect QA screenshots for 10 sample pages
risks: Large-scale instance swaps may cause breakages in customer-facing landing pages that were tweaked to local overrides
Automated swaps risk losing important overrides (icon positions, custom paddings) — need manual review for >100 instances
Publish gating without DesignOps enforcement can be bypassed; requires pipeline or assignment ownership
